scope: attempted to enumerate the client's modules at runtime to check whether cgame is loaded; the ad-hoc script had an argtypes bug and the run ended at state 9
what_was_attempted: run the standard session with snapshot-tr15.bin
at ~40 s after connect, read network state and enumerate loaded modules, looking for cgame / game / ui / render / d3d / ff
the intent was to answer one question directly: does the client ever load its cgame module in our sessions?
what_happened: the run reached state 9, not 10 (so the state does vary between runs with different snapshot bodies)
the enumeration raised OverflowError on GetModuleBaseNameW because the argtypes were not declared - a bug in the ad-hoc script, not in the client
useful_byproducts: the repository already contains tools/modules.py, which was written for exactly this purpose and does declare its types - it should be used instead of an inline script
state 9 vs state 10 varies with the snapshot body, which is itself a signal: tr15 (55 clean bits) ended at 9 while single22 ended at 10
next: run tools/modules.py against a live client during a normal session and record the module list at the loading screen and after it
if cgame is absent, that confirms the load path never reaches cgame initialisation and the work must target the load sequence
if cgame is present, the black frame is a scene/render problem instead, which is a different (and more tractable) investigation
